description: Utilities for making HTTP and HTTPS requests. Provides functions for sending requests, handling responses, managing custom clients, and working with streams and form data.

instructions.description: Sends HTTP or HTTPS request to a given URL. Method, data and additional headers can be specified. This function returns a response object.
instructions.name: Send HTTP request

parameters.description: HTTP method to use
parameters.name: method

parameters.description: URL to send the request to, e.g. 'https://example.com'
parameters.name: url

parameters.description: Headers map
parameters.name: headers

parameters.description: Query params to append to the URL
parameters.name: query

parameters.description: Request body
parameters.name: body

parameters.description: Form that will be serialized as `application/x-www-urlencoded`. Can't be used with body parameter.
parameters.name: form

parameters.description: Name of the HTTP client to use. If none a default worker client will be used.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Flag whether the function should throw when server returns status indicating error (4XX or 5XX). True by default.
parameters.name: throwOnHttpError
